description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Optum Serve is modernizing enterprise technology systems to support federal agencies and improve health services for military members and Veterans. The Full Stack Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and operates applications and production services, collaborates with stakeholders on requirements, and mentors junior engineers.
Full Stack Software Engineer develops and operates applications, translates business requirements into technical solutions, and reviews code

Responsibilities:
• Designs, codes, tests and debugs applications and components that meet all technical specifications and business requirements per assigned work items
• Collaborates closely with stakeholders, product owners, and feature team on developing requirements
• Refines business requirements into technical solutions, recommend alternative technical and business approaches, and lead engineering efforts to meet aggressive timelines with optimal solutions
• Perform code reviews
• Operational Excellence - build, deploy, monitor, and operation of production services
• Communicate effectively with business stakeholders and technical team
• Mentors' junior software engineer

Requirements:
• High School Diploma/GED
• 1+ years of experience leveraging AI tools in the software development lifecycle to improve quality and efficiency
• 1+ years of experience in full lifecycle software development projects in an agile environment
• 1+ years of hands-on technical expertise in building web applications and RESTful web services
• 1+ years of experience with MS SQL, PostgreSQL, or other similar relational database management systems
• 1+ years of experience with .NET Core or similar object-oriented programming language
• 1+ years of experience with Angular, React, or other JavaScript frameworks / libraries
• United States Citizenship required
• Must be able to obtain and maintain a suitability or determination of eligibility for a Confidential/Secret or Top Secret security clearance

Preferred:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or Computer Engineering or related field OR 4 years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Experience with application containerization, deployment, and orchestration across environments
• Experience with CI/CD and test automation
• Experience building cloud-native applications in Azure or similar cloud service provider
• Basic understanding and ability to troubleshoot applications running within Kubernetes
• Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure and automated provisioning & configuration management
• Basic understanding of networking and internet protocols
• Knowledge of Encryption, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), understanding of OWASP
